cozy.note: Lanterns moderated, warm amber. Cozy without the candle spam.

epic.note: Golden sun rays streaming through the glasshouse, monumental and INSIDE this time. Still a full-body figure; identity 0.50 sits right at the gate.

dark.note: Night interior, lanterns and candles, deep blue shadow, the face lit. Exactly the fix.

arcane.note: Hanging lanterns, drifting motes, blossoms. Magic, and the face is clean (0.72).

moonlit.note: Cool silver-blue misty night, lanterns, the face lit (identity 0.73). The faceless derail is gone.

spotlight.note: One bright spot from above, dark blue surroundings, lanterns. The nightclub magenta is gone.

aurora.note: Aurora through the palms with a warm lantern, but the hair and beard went grey again (identity 0.64). The green light ages the face twice in a row.

prism.note: Bright cyan-and-pink garden with faint rainbow light. Pretty, but the accent is weak and the face drifted in both rounds (0.56, 0.57).
